## Checklist

- [ ] One entry per pull request, in `registry/<folder>/<id>.yml`
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes (CI runs it too; don't edit `README.md`, it's rebuilt after merge)
- [ ] The project is built on T3N, and `t3n_features` lists the parts it uses
- [ ] The project is open source under an OSI-approved license and its README says how to run it
- [ ] The summary says what the agent can do safely, without marketing adjectives
- [ ] I'm requesting the **Secured on T3N** badge (workflows only; fill in `contract.wasm_sha256` and the tag to build from)
